claim: A permission set is a collection of permissions you create in IAM Identity Center, modeled on AWS managed policies for job functions or any AWS managed policies; IAM Identity Center applies it to the selected accounts automatically, and when users access the accounts through the AWS access portal, these permissions restrict what they can do within those accounts.

evidence.quote: Permission sets are a collection of permissions that you can create in IAM Identity Center, modelling them based on AWS managed policies for job functions or any AWS managed policies.
IAM Identity Center applies these permissions to the selected accounts automatically.
When your users access the accounts through the AWS access portal, these permissions restrict what they can do within those accounts.
